crimtab.title: Burner
crimtab.volunteers_off: Volunteer suspects are off on this server right now: nobody can be asked.
crimtab.role.driver: Getaway or race driver (your own car)
crimtab.role.fugitive: Fugitive hiding in a search area
crimtab.home.roles_hint: Police running a tablet mission may ask you to play one of these. Untick what you don't want.
crimtab.home.off_text: For the next {minutes} minutes, police running a tablet mission may ask you to play its suspect instead of an NPC. Nothing starts without your yes, and officers never see where you are.
crimtab.home.blocked: Too many strikes: you can get on the list again in about {hours} h.
crimtab.home.agree: I agree to the rules: saying yes and then not showing up or walking away is a strike, {strikes} strikes block me for a while.
crimtab.jobs.reward_money: ${away} if you get away, ${caught} if you are caught (a fair case: police reached you and you played it out)
crimtab.jobs.consent: Accept is your yes: the meet point becomes your map waypoint. Decline costs nothing.
crimtab.jobs.empty_listed: You are on the list. When police take a mission whose suspect you can play, it shows up here.
crimtab.jobs.empty_off: Get on the list on Home to be offered jobs.
crimtab.active.empty: You are not playing a suspect right now.
crimtab.active.rule_stay: Stay in character and in the area the job gives you.
crimtab.active.rule_force: Server rules on force and staging apply.
crimtab.active.rule_log: Logging off or walking away is a strike.
crimtab.active.cancel_free: Giving up now is free (right after your yes, before police reach you).
crimtab.active.cancel_strike: Giving up now is a strike.
crimtab.phase.in_position: In position: police are on their way
crimtab.phase.engaged: Police reached you: play it out
crimtab.history.note: Cases since the last server restart.
crimtab.rules.title: The rules
crimtab.rules.window: You stay on the list for {minutes} minutes; renew it on Home.
crimtab.rules.ask: A job waits {seconds} seconds for your answer. Declining or not answering costs nothing.
crimtab.rules.travel: After Accept you have {minutes} minutes to reach the meet point.
crimtab.rules.cancel: Giving up within {seconds} seconds of your yes, before police reach you, is free.
crimtab.rules.strikes: {strikes} strikes within {hours} h block you from the list for {block} h, on every character.
crimtab.rules.police: Police on duty can't use this tablet, and it never shows where officers are.
crimtab.rules.server: Server rules on force, combat logging and staging always apply.
err.crimtab_off: The criminal tablet is not available on this server.
err.crimtab_on_duty: Police on duty can't use the criminal tablet. Go off duty first.
err.crimtab_police: Police characters can't use the criminal tablet. Use a character that is not police.
err.crimtab_no_access: You don't have access to the criminal tablet. Ask a server admin if you think you should.
err.crimtab_blocked: Too many strikes: Home shows when you can get on the list again.
err.crimtab_job_gone: That job is gone: the question closed or someone else was asked.
err.crimtab_closed: The criminal tablet closed: you can no longer use it.
health.crimtab.ok: The criminal tablet item {item} exists in ox_inventory
health.crimtab.missing: {item} (Config.CriminalTablet.item) is not an ox_inventory item: the criminal tablet cannot be opened with it. Paste its entry from items/ox_inventory_items.lua into ox_inventory, or set the item to false
health.crimtab.no_inventory: ox_inventory is not running: the criminal tablet item {item} cannot be checked or used
crimtab.help.home: Put yourself on the list to be asked to play a suspect, and pick which suspects you play.
crimtab.help.jobs: Accept or decline before the timer runs out; nothing starts without your yes.
crimtab.help.active: Get to the meet point in time and play it out; giving up may cost a strike.
crimtab.help.history: Your past cases and the strikes that still count against you.
crimtab.help.rules: How the list, the questions, the strikes and the blocks work.
